figurative_meaning_en: arrangement for food and clothing (basic means of sustenance)
example_sentences_in_bangla: চাকরিটা না পেলে ভাত-কাপড়ের ব্যবস্থা কীভাবে হবে?
গ্রামে ফসলের উপর নির্ভর করে তাদের ভাত-কাপড় চলে।
example_sentences_in_english: If I don't get the job, how will I manage my food and clothing?
In the village, their food and clothing depend on the harvest.
note: This idiom reflects the fundamental concerns of survival in Bengali society, often used in contexts of employment and agriculture.
